summary.one_liner: This page is the chapter index of Robert Nystrom's free online book Game Programming Patterns, listing the design, sequencing, behavioral, decoupling and optimization patterns it covers.
keywords: gang of four patterns applied to games
takeaways: The book is organized into design patterns revisited, sequencing, behavioral, decoupling, and optimization pattern groups.
Sequencing patterns include Double Buffer, Game Loop, and Update Method.
Decoupling patterns include Component, Event Queue, and Service Locator.
Optimization patterns include Data Locality, Dirty Flag, Object Pool, and Spatial Partition.
The full book is free to read online via the site's chapter links.
summary.summary: This is the table of contents for Game Programming Patterns by Robert Nystrom, which explains software design patterns through game programming. The page lists the chapters grouped into Design Patterns Revisited, Sequencing Patterns, Behavioral Patterns, Decoupling Patterns, and Optimization Patterns, with previous/next navigation for reading the book in order. The page itself contains only the chapter list and navigation, so the details of each pattern are not shown here.
